paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得过去四周一边处理普通事务，一边想到还没收到的答复；另一次已经做完能做的部分，仍难转向别的事。两段分别保留“实际做了什么”和“仍注意到什么”，不证明问题解决、担忧多余或情况安全。例子不要求重开消息、联系对方或反复回顾来判断担心是否合理。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls ordinary tasks alongside thoughts about a missing reply during the past four weeks. On another occasion the available practical step was complete, yet moving on remained difficult. What was done and what still drew attention stay separate. Neither proves a resolved problem, unnecessary worry or a safe situation. The scene requires no reopened message, contact or repeated review to judge whether a concern was reasonable.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得同一担心又出现；实际事情有些还未知；现在想先问怎样描述它。”可以只读虚构卡，不填写担心内容。听者不裁定想太多、不保证事情会顺利，也不要求先停止想法；询问支持无需证明担心达到某种程度，卡片也不是反复取得确定的固定问答。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names a returning concern, leaves practical circumstances partly unknown and asks how to describe it. Read only the fictional card without supplying its content. A listener gives no overthinking verdict, promises no favourable outcome and requires no stopped thought. Asking about support needs no proof of a particular level of worry, and the card is no fixed exchange to repeat until certainty arrives.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是GAD-7、PTQ、PSS-4、诊断或治疗练习。12条仍保留三组各四条的六类记录；计数算描述，不算天数、事件、症状或生活影响，未计分不补零。三个可重叠的主题是编辑分组，不建立原因、严重度或功能结论。原观察尚无独立验证、常模或中英文测量等值；四周是编辑回忆时段，不是诊断时长或求助等待期。PTQ、月度压力及睡眠回顾保留各自范围，回答与数字不互补或合并。任何组合不解释身体感觉为无害，不替代合适评估及已有专业意见。三篇全文与支持说明无需作答；复制仅含公开标题与入口，不含私人类别、担心内容或健康资料。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not GAD-7, PTQ, PSS-4, diagnosis or treatment exercises. Twelve descriptions retain three six-category records of four. Counts concern descriptions, not days, events, symptoms or amounts of impact; unscored is not zero. Three overlapping topics are editorial groupings and establish no cause, severity or functional conclusion. The original observations lack independent validation, norms or established English–Chinese measurement equivalence; four weeks is an editorial recall window, not a diagnostic duration or waiting period for support. PTQ, monthly stress and sleep reflections keep their own scope without supplied answers or combined numbers. No pattern establishes that a bodily feeling is harmless or replaces appropriate assessment and existing professional advice. All three guides and support information need no answers. Copying contains only the public title and entry, without private categories, worry content or health information.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得两项活动之间难以安定，另一个时刻则注意到紧绷时较难忍受打断，却不知道背景是否相同。这些是不同回忆，不合成身体状态、愤怒问题或焦虑原因。例子不要求现在感觉肌肉、测试静坐、改变呼吸或再次接受打断；未记得的细节可以保持未知。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls difficulty settling between activities and, on another occasion, finding an interruption harder to tolerate while tense, without knowing whether the contexts were alike. These remain different recollections rather than one bodily state, anger problem or anxiety explanation. The scene requires no present muscle attention, stillness test, altered breathing or further interruption. Unremembered details can remain unknown.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡分开“记得的感觉或活动需要”“不知道的背景”和“想询问的问题”，可以完全谈虚构例子。听者不要求示范身体感觉，不把想动等同自制不足，也不保证感觉只是焦虑。描述可以保持有限，已有支持与合适评估不等待卡片完成或感觉再次出现。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates a remembered feeling or movement need, unknown context and a question, using only a fictional example if preferred. A listener requests no bodily demonstration, equates no wish to move with poor self-control and offers no reassurance of only anxiety. The account can remain limited; existing support and appropriate assessment need not wait for a completed card or a recurring sensation.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得一项任务推迟时脑中有担心，也有资料没到；另一天紧绷之后感到疲惫，却不清楚原因。任务、担心、先后顺序与未知可以分开，不合成效率或健康判断。例子不要求完成任务、检验注意、延迟睡眠或证明担心造成疲惫，也不靠别的主题补全未计分。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls worry alongside a postponed task and missing information. On another day tiredness followed tension without a known cause. Task, concern, sequence and unknowns stay separate without a productivity or health verdict. The scene requires no completed task, attention test, delayed sleep or proof that worry caused fatigue, and uses no other topic to fill an unscored answer.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想分别谈任务里的打断、安睡时的担心或后来疲惫；不确定它们是否相关；私人细节想保留。”可以只读，任选一个有用问题，不必列齐三项。听者不评价懒惰、不把先后解释成因果，也不提供睡眠或任务管理处方；支持不以先完成事务或提供工作记录为条件。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card keeps task interruptions, worry around settling for sleep and later tiredness separate, leaves their connection unknown and keeps details private. Read only and choose one useful question without listing every experience. A listener gives no laziness judgment, turns no sequence into a cause and prescribes no sleep or task-management plan. Support does not depend on first finishing a task or providing workplace records.
